get_generator: get the do_generate function and initialized generator object for a given generator name and file path
init_generator_analogies: initialize an analogy generator by loading a trained model state from a generator file
do_generate_analogies: generate synthetic feature vectors and labels using an analogy-based generator to augment training data
review_get_generator: review the get_generator dispatcher function that maps generator names to their init and generate functions
summarize_generation_module: summarize the generation module that dispatches analogy generation via init_generator and do_generate dictionaries
